content.text:
Found it. The commit `179e7cf` renamed the main package but forgot to rename the corresponding test file, leaving a mismatch that later caused test initialization failures fixed in HEAD.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 179e7cfa7c2f0ecb06cf918e0151993e6f8d6a22

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** The fix commit renames the package declaration inside `YuleApplicationTests.java` from `com.github.piotr.rusin.yule` to `com.github.piotr_rusin.yule` to match the main source tree. I checked when the test file was created and when the main package used the underscore naming. `git log --diff-filter=A` showed `YuleApplicationTests.java` was added in the `Initial commit` (`1e4061d`) under `src/test/java/com/github/piotr/rusin/yule/` (no underscore). I then looked for when the main package was renamed and found commit `179e7cf` ("Rename a package"), which renamed `YuleApplication.java` from `com/github/piotr/rusin/yule` to `com/github/piotr_rusin/yule`.

**(2) Specific change:** Commit `179e7cf` only renamed the main application class's directory/package (`src/main/java/.../piotr/rusin/... → piotr_rusin/...`), touching a single file. It did not perform the equivalent rename on the test file `YuleApplicationTests.java`, which was left in the old `com.github.piotr.rusin.yule` package. From that point on, the main and test trees disagreed on the base package name.

**(3) Evidence:** The Initial commit created both files with matching `com.github.piotr.rusin.yule` packages, so there was no inconsistency at that point. The rename commit's diff shows it explicitly changed only `YuleApplication.java`'s package (and correspondingly moved it under `piotr_rusin`), with no corresponding change to the test file. All subsequent commits (verified via `git log --oneline -- src/main/java/com/github/piotr_rusin`) continued building out the `piotr_rusin` package for main sources, while the test file, unmodified until the bug-fix commit, remained under the stale `piotr.rusin` package — exactly the mismatch that `43d9003` fixes by finally renaming the test file's package/directory to match.

I'm confident in this identification since the fix is a direct, isolated correction of the omission in `179e7cf`, and no other commit touched the test file's package in between.
